products.description: The Roborock Q5 Pro Black vacuum and mop robot has a power of 5,500 Pa and, thanks to its DuoRoller brush, removes even deep-rooted pet hair. The device can clean your home for up to four hours on a single battery charge.
products.highlights: Efficient vacuum robot with large dust box, If you live in a small to medium-sized household with pets , various types of dirt accumulate daily. While small patches of dirt can be easily removed with a cordless vacuum cleaner , robot vacuums like the Q5 Pro are the best choice for deep cleaning. The device is equipped with a double roller for mixed flooring . The DuoRoller brush consists of two rotating solid rubber brushes designed to loosen even stubborn dirt. This, along with fine dust, sand, and hair, is then drawn into the dust container. The manufacturer offers the following additional features with the Roborock model:
functions: LiDAR navigation and 3D mapping in the app
pros: for small to medium living spaces

functions: absorb not only dust and everyday dirt, but also pet hair.
pros: good suction power on hard floors (5000 Pa)
automatic emptying in suction station (3.0 L)
